notablePrerequisites: Ulasht has at least one removable +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ulasht by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {R}.
When the Saproling dies, Sadistic Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ulasht.
Repeat.
